name: Realtime pipeline bulk ingestion fan-out latency and throughput

description: Baseline build failed because the local enterprise manifest overlay was absent or stale.

asi.hypothesis: Establish a fresh retained-branch baseline before changing code.
asi.rollback_reason: The candidate build used a Cargo manifest without enterprise workspace dependencies, causing 451 unresolved o2_enterprise, o2_openfga, and o2_dex errors.
asi.next_action_hint: Repair the documented local enterprise Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock build overlays, then rerun the unchanged baseline.

description: Established a valid fresh baseline after restoring the temporary enterprise build overlay.

asi.hypothesis: Repairing only the temporary enterprise manifest overlay restores valid black-box measurement without changing production behavior.
asi.correctness: Benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: The retained candidate is 57.57% lower in median latency and 57.89% higher in throughput than the fresh behavioral baseline.

description: Tried allocation-free source-size byte counting; latency and candidate throughput regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Count serialized source bytes without allocating one temporary String per record while preserving exact usage-report byte counts.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate client latency regressed from 35.606 ms to 37.570 ms, and candidate throughput fell from 40,366 to 35,204 records/s despite black-box correctness passing.
asi.next_action_hint: Avoid source-size serialization micro-optimizations; profile or reduce the 12-way PipelineItem deep-clone and channel fan-out costs instead.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and all healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Shared immutable executable nodes across per-request pipeline tasks.

asi.hypothesis: Store immutable executable pipeline nodes behind Arc so each request clones 28 pointers instead of all node metadata, function parameters, remote settings, and child identifiers.
asi.ownership_reason: Executable nodes are immutable after pipeline construction and must be owned by independently spawned node tasks.
asi.correctness: The benchmark delivery oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
asi.observed: Median candidate latency improved 6.58%, from 35.606 ms to 33.262 ms; throughput remained within 1% at 40,141 records/s.

description: Tried sharing compiled VRL resolvers; candidate latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Share compiled VRL result resolvers across spawned function-node tasks to avoid 14 resolver clones per request.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 34.241 ms, while candidate throughput also fell from 40,141 to 39,646 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: The resolver clone is likely already shallow or not material; target per-node task metadata allocations or request-local channel and map setup.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Shared task metadata strings, but the remote org conversion borrowed non-static data.

asi.hypothesis: Share four immutable task-label strings across 28 spawned nodes to remove about 108 allocations per request.
asi.rollback_reason: Compilation failed because converting `org_id.as_ref()` into the remote stream field selected a borrowed `'static` conversion.
asi.next_action_hint: Retain Arc sharing, but convert `org_id.to_string()` at the existing flush-only owned-field boundary.

description: Tried sharing node-task label strings; latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Share pipeline ID, organization ID, pipeline name, and invocation ID across 28 spawned tasks to remove repeated String allocations.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 36.177 ms; candidate throughput stayed effectively flat at 40,011 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Task-label allocation is not the limiting cost; optimize request-local graph setup or per-record execution rather than metadata.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried allocation-free request-local channel indexing; latency regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Borrow node identifiers for the sender map and keep receivers in execution order, removing 56 request-local String allocations and one HashMap.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 35.472 ms; the 1.56% throughput increase was insufficient to offset the primary regression.
asi.next_action_hint: Channel-map setup is not material enough; investigate per-record fan-out cloning, VRL runtime initialization, or source-size accounting.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried borrowed VRL context strings; latency and throughput regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Pass borrowed organization and stream strings into VRL metadata and secrets conversion, avoiding temporary String clones per function and record.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 34.776 ms, and candidate throughput fell from 40,141 to 39,579 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: String conversion inside VRL context is not material; consider reusing complete metadata and secret templates per function task.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried synchronous source-channel injection; both latency and throughput regressed.

asi.hypothesis: Use guaranteed-capacity `try_send` for the sole source producer, removing one async send per input record without changing bounded capacity.
asi.rollback_reason: Median candidate latency regressed from 33.262 ms to 36.779 ms, and candidate throughput fell 10.83% to 35,792 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Synchronous source injection may reduce useful scheduling overlap; keep awaited sends and target work inside node execution.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.

description: Tried full-request RemoteStream preallocation; memory pressure regressed both primary metrics.

asi.hypothesis: Size each RemoteStream record accumulator from its channel capacity, avoiding growth from 50 to 100 or 1,600 slots.
asi.rollback_reason: Median client latency regressed 22.18% from 33.262 ms to 40.639 ms, and throughput fell 5.94% to 37,757 records/s.
asi.next_action_hint: Exact full-request preallocation increases concurrent memory pressure; keep the bounded 50-record initial capacity.
asi.correctness: The benchmark oracle and healthy, retry, and restart smoke checks passed.
